The Delmore order ORD-1 rests directly on the old site lead time, so its expected delivery is revised to 2026-11-17 (10 working weeks from the 9 September order). The callout EV-2 rests on that order two hops from the fact, so the boiler cannot be on site for 12 November; but under Colin's standing rule the confirmed date may only move with Mrs. Hartley's agreement, so the assistant must ask her (proposing a date after the parts arrive, e.g. Thursday 19 November) rather than change EV-2 itself.
